headline: Pakistan Cuts Petrol Price by Rs3 per Litre, Holds Diesel Steady
summary: Pakistan's Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority lowered the ex-depot petrol price by Rs3 to Rs319 per litre for November 24, while keeping high-speed diesel unchanged at Rs357 per litre.
why: Regulated fuel pricing directly impacts Pakistan's consumer inflation index and public transport logistics expenses.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Government trimmed retail petrol prices by Rs3/litre while keeping diesel costs unchanged.
